caption: The drawing depicts two views of an object resembling a tortoise on a light beige background. The upper portion of the composition shows a realistic, three-dimensional representation of a tortoise, primarily rendered in shades of brown, with detailed texturing on the shell and limbs to mimic the appearance of reptilian skin and scales. The tortoise is positioned facing to the right, and its four legs are outstretched, supporting the body above the surface. Below this, the lower portion of the drawing presents a diagrammatic, less detailed, grayscale rendering of the same tortoise-shaped object with its shell hinged open. The inside reveals a circular container or compartment, suggesting the tortoise is a lidded vessel. The cavity beneath the open shell is outlined, with structural elements connecting the top and bottom parts depicted. The orientation and placement of both images align vertically on the page, and the drawing style combines color realism with technical illustration.
title: Cuspidor
